caption: The drawing features a round, shallow plate depicted in the center of the page. The plate is shown from a top-down perspective and is outlined in black ink, with areas of blue detailing on the upper interior and lower edge of the plate, which appear as a decorative pattern. Below the main depiction, there is a side view of the plate enclosed in a box, with dimensions given as 5 5/8 inches in diameter and 1 1/8 inches in height, and a scale note of 1/4. The upper left corner of the main rectangular frame includes the scale notation "3/4." The drawing also includes the name "Jos Sudek Jr." written in the lower right, outside the side view box, and all components are arranged neatly on an off-white background.
title: Saucer
